operation: Read-only scientific source/data synchronization into a new Git branch
source_roots: new-server migration records verified against the server
include: Exact secondary-off and sequential illustration HDF5 trajectories and source identities
Compact MP4s and PNG/PDF paper exports
Migration environment locks, bounded GPU checks, successful and failed attempt logs
Current server/deletion handoff and relative input links
exclude: Virtual environments and managed Python runtimes
Downloaded wheels, compiled binaries and CUDA caches
Large historical response-node and contact/event streams
Rebuildable previews/extracted frames and duplicate TIFF/SVG exports in new result folders
Derived trajectory NPZ duplicates where original HDF5 is retained
Credentials, SSH keys and account configuration
source_hash_policy: Copied scientific artifacts are byte-identical; original full-export manifests retained with explicit exclusions
metadata_projection: Local backup deletion receipt omits unrelated sibling project paths/inodes and records its original SHA256
larger_existing_input_exception: The already-tracked 33287981-byte acoustic basis is inherited unchanged, not newly uploaded
deleted_local_full_backup: Deleted by explicit user request on 2026-10-10; not an available recovery source
